name: Security Control Mapping (Contoso)
tagline: Maps security controls to solution components · runs in Microsoft Foundry
instructions: Drafts control-to-component mappings for the tailored security control list (NIST SP 800-53 and the NIST AI RMF), with the evidence each control needs and a gap register. Mappings are drafts for the security team to review.
starters: Map the AC and IA controls in the attached SCTM to the attached architecture

attachHint: Attach the tailored SCTM (.xlsx or .json) and the solution architecture (.docx, .pdf or .md); optionally a components list (.json with 'component' in the name).
